summary: Session 93 premise-verified infrastructure audit with public-release and game-loop lenses. Five findings survived live-code review: browser-authored narration can trigger server AI without certified game authority; multiple Worker feature authorities are unreachable and one parallel Intel market returns invented uncharged risk; pre-match intelligence has no stale-session or timeout ownership; the generated public shell and application footer use separate route authorities; and the new transport recovery state is test-visible but player-invisible while fatal refusal still calls alert(). External launch observations remain NO-GO and are not implementation claims.

infrastructure.result: Worker route reachability, browser-authored authority, remote-AI admission surfaces, lifecycle ownership, duplicated navigation producers, god-object boundaries, workflow freshness, dependency posture, and local release evidence were inspected against live sources.

gameLoop.result: The certified Capture-to-Breach loop and progression spine are strong. The highest-value remaining player seams are truthful live narration, lifecycle-safe pre-match intelligence, and legible recovery during multiplayer disruption. Soul fidelity remains intentionally unscored because the public SOUL file contains no evaluable pillars.

items.title: Make live narration inherit server-certified match authority
items.why: NarratorReporter lets any browser POST an arbitrary activity and label for any gameId into NarratorBus. The server validates shape and IP rate only; it does not verify actor membership, live game ownership, or that the event occurred. GameServer imports NarratorBus only to close it, so AI commentary can be driven by browser-authored fiction.
items.recipe: Project a privacy-minimal narration event only after GameServer accepts authoritative intents and certified lifecycle outcomes; remove the public narrator event mutation and client reporter; preserve bounded SSE subscription; define a typed event catalog with no actor identifiers; lower the public-ingest ceiling; and prove fake game IDs, rejected intents, duplicate events, and browser posts cannot trigger commentary.

L2.recipe: Emit narration from accepted GameServer events and remove the client reporter.

L3.recipe: Certified typed projection, privacy-minimal deduplication, route-policy contraction, integrity counters, and adversarial tests.

executionLog: Removed the browser-writable narrator event route and NarratorReporter client mutation.
Added a typed privacy-minimal projection after GameServer intent admission; rejected intents and caller prose cannot enter narration.
Added a deterministic certified baseline with optional remote enrichment, a visible aria-live consumer, and adversarial authority tests.
Contract result: 29 declared/registered mutations, public ingest 4/4.

items.title: Give every runtime feature authority a reachable consumer or retire it
items.why: Worker exposes multiple feature surfaces with no client, agent, or operator consumer: match-mission, match-commentary, bot-lore, match-coach, clan-war, and parallel Intel market routes. The Intel routes accept caller identities, keep unbounded game maps, return random fallback risk, advertise a 2,000-gold cost, and never mutate the certified economy. Unused Api helpers also preserve phantom battle-narrative and bot-persona authority.
items.recipe: Create an executable runtime-feature reachability catalog that binds each admitted route to a source consumer and audience. Remove unreachable routes, imports, stores, client helpers, policies, and tests; keep core in-match Intel commands as the sole economy authority; forbid random quote data and uncharged cost claims; ratchet Worker and public-ingest ceilings downward; and mutation-test reintroduction.

L1.recipe: Remove the unconsumed Intel HTTP market and random quote fallback.

L2.recipe: Retire all verified unreachable feature clusters and reconcile policies/imports.

L3.recipe: Source-backed reachability catalog, measurable composition contraction, exact route-policy ceilings, and negative reintroduction tests.

executionLog: Retired fourteen verified unreachable routes across battle narrative, commentary, missions, bot lore/persona, match coach, Intel HTTP market, clan war, and browser narrator ingestion.
Removed the unreachable ClanWarStore and client helpers while preserving and explicitly cataloging the live micro-coach and progression router.
Added a source-backed catalog for eight admitted route→transport→consumer chains, fourteen retired-route tombstones, mutation tests, doctor coverage, and a sha256 evidence digest.
Worker contracted from 2,849 audited lines to 2,420 with a 2,440-line ratchet.

items.title: Make pre-match intelligence bounded, abortable, and stale-session-proof
items.why: GameStartingModal launches three provider-backed requests with Promise.all and owns neither an AbortController nor a session generation. hide() leaves requests and two timeouts alive; an earlier match can overwrite a later modal, and the fixed 300px surface can overflow when all three cards arrive on mobile. There is no focused lifecycle test.
items.recipe: Introduce a generation-scoped pre-match session with AbortController, bounded per-task deadlines, all-settled status, timer cleanup, stale-result rejection, and exact hide/disconnect teardown. Render an accessible responsive shell with deterministic loading/degraded states, validate provider payloads before projection, and capture desktop/mobile evidence across all themes.

L1.recipe: Reject stale async results and clear timers on hide.

L2.recipe: Add abort signals, per-task deadlines, and lifecycle tests.

L3.recipe: Session receipt, accessible responsive state machine, three-theme desktop/mobile rendered proof, and exact cleanup invariants.

executionLog: Added generation ownership, AbortController propagation, a six-second deadline, all-settled projection, stale-result rejection, and exact timer teardown.
Added accessible loading/degraded/ready states and a 92vw/32rem, 85dvh responsive dialog.
Focused lifecycle tests prove hide abort and cross-match stale suppression; the three-state desktop/mobile/theme matrix is included in the 90-artifact visual receipt.

items.title: Generate static and in-app public navigation from one route graph
items.why: public/footer-manifest.json generates and validates ten static pages, but the Lit application footer repeats routes, copyright, brand, and attribution by hand. It omits the required Play destination and adds Wiki/Source links outside the checked graph, so the green footer gate does not cover the actual app footer.
items.recipe: Make one typed public route manifest drive static shell generation and the Lit footer projection, explicitly classify app-only external links, and extend the scoped checker to validate the application consumer. Preserve ordering, labels, legal pages, branding, upstream attribution, and current visual output; add digest/reachability tests and close the local half of the aged SIL item without claiming staging screenshots.

L1.recipe: Import footer links from the existing manifest into the app.

L2.recipe: Type the manifest and include app-only external links.

L3.recipe: One projection authority, app/static parity checker, digest evidence, and drift mutation tests.

executionLog: Created src/shared/PublicRouteGraph.json as the canonical typed route graph and kept public/footer-manifest.json as an exact checked mirror.
The static shell generator and Lit footer now project the same seven routes, ownership, copyright, attribution, and two classified app-external links.
Footer checker now validates app consumption, mirror parity, hard-coded-route absence, and a sha256 graph digest.

items.title: Turn transport recovery evidence into calm player-visible state
items.why: Transport now emits exact connection state, retry attempt, outbox depth, and overflow events, but only tests consume them. Players see no waiting/recovering/synchronized feedback, queued actions are invisible, and protocol refusal still uses blocking alert(), bypassing the app's accessible modal and theme system.
items.recipe: Add a dedicated recovery presenter subscribed to transport state/overflow events: a non-blocking aria-live banner for waiting/recovering/synchronized states, queued-action count and reject-newest overflow guidance, and an accessible fatal-refusal modal. Keep transient states generation-safe, never claim synchronized before rejoin succeeds, test event-to-view semantics, and capture all themes at desktop/mobile widths.

L1.recipe: Replace alert() with the existing modal path.

L2.recipe: Render waiting/recovery/overflow state from transport events.

L3.recipe: Accessible generation-safe presenter, honest synchronization lifecycle, theme/mobile proof, and adversarial event tests.

executionLog: Added an accessible player-visible presenter for connecting, waiting, synchronizing, restored, fatal refusal, and reject-newest overflow states.
Removed blocking alert(), sanitized fatal reason text, and bound retry/outbox language to exact transport events.
Reordered transport truth so open is published only after authoritative rejoin and FIFO flush; focused tests prove one zero-depth open event.
All five states pass desktop/mobile/theme rendered proof.
